description: always on: find, build, bind and audit

tools.name: figma_get_status
tools.summary: Check connection status to Figma Desktop.

tools.name: figma_diagnose
tools.summary: Designer-readable health check for this server.

tools.name: figma_list_open_files
tools.summary: List all Figma files currently connected via the Desktop Bridge plugin.

tools.name: figma_navigate
tools.summary: Switch the active file among files where the Desktop Bridge is running (it doesn't open files; see figma_list_open_files).

tools.name: figma_reconnect
tools.summary: Force a complete reconnection to Figma Desktop.

tools.name: figma_get_selection
tools.summary: Get the currently selected nodes in Figma.

tools.name: figma_capture_screenshot
tools.summary: Screenshot a node (or the current page) from the live plugin state, so it reflects changes made a moment ago.

tools.name: figma_execute
tools.summary: Run JavaScript in the Figma plugin context (full figma API) for anything other tools don't cover.

tools.name: figma_get_design_system_summary
tools.summary: Get a compact overview of the design system.

tools.name: figma_search_components
tools.summary: Search components by name, category or description; returns keys and node IDs to instantiate.

tools.name: figma_resolve_components
tools.summary: Before building from a design system, map each UI element the request needs (plain words, e.g.

tools.name: figma_instantiate_component
tools.summary: Place an instance of a component.

tools.name: figma_set_instance_properties
tools.summary: Set an instance's component properties (TEXT, BOOLEAN, INSTANCE_SWAP, VARIANT) by name u2014 the way to change content inside an instance, since editing its text layers directly fails silently.

tools.name: figma_create_child
tools.summary: Create a new child node inside a parent container.

tools.name: figma_clone_node
tools.summary: Duplicate a node. The clone is placed at a slight offset from the original.

tools.name: figma_move_node
tools.summary: Move a node to a new position within its parent.

tools.name: figma_resize_node
tools.summary: Resize a node to specific dimensions.

tools.name: figma_rename_node
tools.summary: Rename a node in the layer panel.

tools.name: figma_delete_node
tools.summary: Delete a node from the canvas.

tools.name: figma_set_layout
tools.summary: Set a frame's auto layout or grid layout in one call, and place its children.

tools.name: figma_set_fills
tools.summary: Set the fill colors on a node.

tools.name: figma_set_strokes
tools.summary: Set the stroke (border) on a node.

tools.name: figma_set_text
tools.summary: Set a text node's content and optionally its font size, family/style ('Semi Bold'; no-space forms are auto-corrected), wrap style (BALANCE, PRETTY) and variable-font axes.

tools.name: figma_bind_tokens
tools.summary: Bind a node's spacing, radius, size, stroke weight, opacity and typography to EXISTING variables, and apply a text or effect style, by name or id.

tools.name: figma_get_variables
tools.summary: Read the file's variables (design tokens): collections, modes and values.

tools.name: figma_get_text_styles
tools.summary: Get all local text styles in the current file.

tools.name: figma_audit_adherence
tools.summary: Check a built frame against the design system: hand-built look-alikes of components and new components (errors), hand-drawn vectors, values not bound to variables or styles, instance style overrides,

tools.name: figma_lint_design
tools.summary: Check a node tree (or the current page) for WCAG 2.2 problems — contrast, non-text contrast, color-only meaning, focus indicators, target size, alt text, headings, reflow, reading order, disabled cont

tools.name: figma_enable_toolsets
tools.summary: Switch on more tools when a task needs them (the core set covers finding, building, binding, auditing).

tools.name: figma_call
tools.summary: Run a tool from an enabled toolset by name, if your tool list didn't refresh after figma_enable_toolsets.

description: file data, component dev specs and CSS, styles, library components/variables, where an asset is used

tools.name: figma_get_file_data
tools.summary: Get full file structure and document tree.

tools.name: figma_get_file_for_plugin
tools.summary: Get file data optimized for plugin development with filtered properties (IDs, structure, plugin data, component relationships).

tools.name: figma_get_component
tools.summary: Get a single component's metadata or reconstruction specification.

tools.name: figma_get_component_details
tools.summary: Get full details for a specific component including all variants, properties, and keys needed for instantiation.

tools.name: figma_get_component_image
tools.summary: Render a specific component or node as an image (PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF).

tools.name: figma_get_component_for_development
tools.summary: Get component data optimized for high-fidelity UI implementation.

tools.name: figma_get_component_for_development_deep
tools.summary: Get a deeply nested component tree with full visual properties, resolved design token names, instance references, prototype interactions, and annotations at every level.

tools.name: figma_analyze_component_set
tools.summary: Analyze a Figma COMPONENT_SET to extract variant state machine and cross-variant diffs for code generation.

tools.name: figma_get_styles
tools.summary: Get all styles (color, text, effects, grids) from a Figma file with optional code exports.

tools.name: figma_get_token_values
tools.summary: Get actual values for design tokens (colors, spacing, etc).

tools.name: figma_browse_tokens
tools.summary: Open an interactive browser to explore design tokens (variables) from a Figma file.

tools.name: figma_take_screenshot
tools.summary: Export an image of the current Figma page or specific node.

tools.name: figma_get_design_changes
tools.summary: Get recent document changes detected in Figma.

tools.name: figma_get_design_system_kit
tools.summary: PREFERRED TOOL for design system extraction — replaces separate figma_get_styles, figma_get_variables, and figma_get_component calls.

tools.name: figma_get_library_components
tools.summary: Discover published components from a shared/team library file.

tools.name: figma_get_library_component_by_key
tools.summary: Get full property definitions, variants, and visual specs for a SINGLE published library component using only its component key.

tools.name: figma_get_library_variables
tools.summary: List all variables from team libraries the current file has subscribed.

tools.name: figma_import_library_variable
tools.summary: Import a single variable from a subscribed team library into the current file.

tools.name: figma_set_image_fill
tools.summary: Set an image fill on one or more Figma nodes.

tools.name: figma_find_usages
tools.summary: Where is a style, variable or component used in this file?

description: edit variables/collections/modes; extended collections (create from a library or local collection, reset overrides); import/export tokens (DTCG, CSS, Tailwind)

tools.name: figma_create_variable
tools.summary: Create a single Figma variable.

tools.name: figma_create_variable_collection
tools.summary: Create an empty variable collection.

tools.name: figma_batch_create_variables
tools.summary: Create multiple variables in one operation.

tools.name: figma_setup_design_tokens
tools.summary: Create a complete design token structure in one operation: collection, modes, and all variables.

tools.name: figma_add_mode
tools.summary: Add a new mode to an existing Figma variable collection.

tools.name: figma_update_variable
tools.summary: Update a single variable's value and/or its description.

tools.name: figma_batch_update_variables
tools.summary: Update multiple variable values in one operation.

tools.name: figma_rename_variable
tools.summary: Rename an existing Figma variable.

tools.name: figma_rename_mode
tools.summary: Rename an existing mode in a Figma variable collection.

tools.name: figma_delete_variable
tools.summary: Delete a Figma variable.

tools.name: figma_delete_variable_collection
tools.summary: Delete a Figma variable collection and ALL its variables.

tools.name: figma_import_tokens
tools.summary: Push design tokens from your codebase into Figma as variables.

tools.name: figma_export_tokens
tools.summary: Export Figma variables to design token files in your codebase.

tools.name: figma_extend_library_collection
tools.summary: Create an extended collection (Enterprise): it inherits every variable of a library collection (collectionKey) or of one of this file's own collections (collectionId), and overrides values per mode, e.g.

tools.name: figma_reset_variable_override
tools.summary: Put a variable in an extended collection back to the value it inherits, removing the extension's override.

description: author component sets, variants, properties, slots; dev resource links

tools.name: figma_create_component_set
tools.summary: Create a component set with variants in one call — replaces hand-written figma.combineAsVariants scripts.

tools.name: figma_arrange_component_set
tools.summary: Organize a component set with Figma's native purple dashed visualization.

tools.name: figma_add_component_property
tools.summary: Add a new component property to a component or component set.

tools.name: figma_edit_component_property
tools.summary: Edit an existing component property.

tools.name: figma_delete_component_property
tools.summary: Delete a component property.

tools.name: figma_set_description
tools.summary: Set the description text on a component, component set, or style.

tools.name: figma_get_slots
tools.summary: List SlotNode children on a component, component set, or instance.

tools.name: figma_create_slot
tools.summary: Create a SlotNode inside a component using createSlot().

tools.name: figma_add_slot_property
tools.summary: Manually add a SLOT component property and bind it to an existing frame (alternative to figma_create_slot).

tools.name: figma_append_to_slot
tools.summary: Add content to a slot on a component instance.

tools.name: figma_reset_slot
tools.summary: Reset a slot on a component instance to its default (empty) state from the main component.

tools.name: figma_manage_dev_resources
tools.summary: List, add, edit or delete the dev resources on components: the links to their code, Storybook or docs that Dev Mode shows.

description: design↔code parity, code adherence and accessibility audits, DS health reports, library analytics

tools.name: figma_check_library_parity
tools.summary: Library-level parity between a Figma component library and its code counterpart: which components exist on both sides, which are only in Figma, and which are only in code.

tools.name: figma_check_design_parity
tools.summary: Compare a Figma component's design specs against code-side data to find discrepancies.

tools.name: figma_audit_code_adherence
tools.summary: Check generated CODE against the design system — the code-side twin of figma_audit_adherence and the evidence for an independent grader.

tools.name: figma_audit_component_accessibility
tools.summary: Deep accessibility audit for a specific component or component set.

tools.name: figma_scan_code_accessibility
tools.summary: Scan HTML code for accessibility violations using axe-core (Deque).

tools.name: figma_audit_design_system_report
tools.summary: Run the design-system health audit and return the scored report as data (no UI required).

tools.name: figma_audit_design_system
tools.summary: Analyze the health and AI-readiness of a Figma file's design system.

tools.name: figma_get_library_analytics
tools.summary: How a published library is used across the organization: instances per component/style/variable and which are unused (usages), or insertions and detachments over time — high detach rates point at comp

description: component docs, version history, changelogs, comments, annotations

tools.name: figma_generate_component_doc
tools.summary: Generate AI-complete component documentation from a Figma component.

tools.name: figma_get_file_versions
tools.summary: List a Figma file's version history with metadata (label, description, author, timestamp).

tools.name: figma_get_file_at_version
tools.summary: Fetch a Figma file (or specific nodes) as it existed at a past version_id.

tools.name: figma_diff_versions
tools.summary: Diff two versions of a Figma file.

tools.name: figma_get_changes_since_version
tools.summary: Convenience wrapper for figma_diff_versions: compares a given version against the current HEAD.

tools.name: figma_generate_changelog
tools.summary: Generate a human-readable markdown changelog between two versions.

tools.name: figma_blame_node
tools.summary: Find the version that introduced a specific change to a node — answers 'who/when added this'.

tools.name: figma_get_comments
tools.summary: Get comment threads on a Figma file.

tools.name: figma_post_comment
tools.summary: Post a comment on a Figma file, optionally pinned to a specific design node.

tools.name: figma_delete_comment
tools.summary: Delete a comment from a Figma file by its comment ID.

tools.name: figma_get_annotations
tools.summary: Read annotations from a Figma node.

tools.name: figma_get_annotation_categories
tools.summary: List available annotation categories in the current Figma file.

tools.name: figma_set_annotations
tools.summary: Write or clear annotations on a Figma node.

description: plugin console, reload/pairing, code across files

tools.name: figma_get_console_logs
tools.summary: Retrieve console logs captured by the Desktop Bridge plugin: console output from code run through it (figma_execute and the other write tools) and from the bridge itself.

tools.name: figma_watch_console
tools.summary: Stream console logs captured by the Desktop Bridge plugin in real-time for a specified duration (max 5 minutes).

tools.name: figma_clear_console
tools.summary: Clear the console log buffer.

tools.name: figma_reload_plugin
tools.summary: Reload the current Figma page/plugin to test code changes.

tools.name: figma_pair_plugin
tools.summary: Cloud pairing. Named in the toolset list but not registered in this local build.

tools.name: figma_execute_across_files
tools.summary: Run the same JavaScript against multiple Figma files connected via the Desktop Bridge plugin, IN PARALLEL, without touching the active file or target lock.

tools.name: figma_get_animations
tools.summary: Read a node's Motion animations: applied animation styles (Figma presets and custom styles, with their entries), manual keyframe tracks, timelines and the playhead.

tools.name: figma_apply_animation
tools.summary: Animate a node with Figma Motion.

tools.name: figma_remove_animation
tools.summary: Remove animations from a node: one applied animation style (appliedId, from figma_get_animations), one manual keyframe track, or everything (all: true).

tools.name: figma_manage_animation_styles
tools.summary: Manage reusable Motion animation styles, the motion layer of a design system.

tools.name: figma_export_animation
tools.summary: Export an animated frame as MP4, GIF or WebM.

tools.name: figma_list_shaders
tools.summary: List shaders: the ones applied in this file (fills, strokes and effects), with each property's name, type and default, and the layers using them; plus shaders from the user's libraries (figma.listAvailableShaders).

tools.name: figma_apply_shader
tools.summary: Apply a shader to a node's fills, strokes or effects, or change the properties of one already applied.

tools.name: figma_get_code_layers
tools.summary: Find code layers (Figma's React code layers, node type CODE_INSTANCE) on the current page or across the file, with position, size, page, and any dev resources or related links (e.g.

tools.name: figjam_get_board_contents
tools.summary: Read all content from a FigJam board.

tools.name: figjam_get_connections
tools.summary: Read the connection graph from a FigJam board.

tools.name: figjam_create_sticky
tools.summary: Create a sticky note on a FigJam board.

tools.name: figjam_create_stickies
tools.summary: Batch create multiple sticky notes on a FigJam board (max ).

tools.name: figjam_create_connector
tools.summary: Connect two nodes with a connector line in FigJam.

tools.name: figjam_create_shape_with_text
tools.summary: Create a labeled shape on a FigJam board with optional size, colors, and font control.

tools.name: figjam_create_section
tools.summary: Create a section on a FigJam board.

tools.name: figjam_create_table
tools.summary: Create a table on a FigJam board with optional cell data.

tools.name: figjam_create_code_block
tools.summary: Create a code block on a FigJam board.

tools.name: figjam_auto_arrange
tools.summary: Arrange nodes on a FigJam board in a grid, horizontal row, or vertical column layout.

tools.name: figma_list_slides
tools.summary: List all slides in the current Figma Slides presentation with their IDs, names, grid positions, and skip status.

tools.name: figma_get_slide_content
tools.summary: Get the content tree of a specific slide including all text, shapes, and frames.

tools.name: figma_get_slide_grid
tools.summary: Get the 2D slide grid layout showing how slides are organized in rows and columns.

tools.name: figma_get_slide_transition
tools.summary: Get the current transition settings for a slide (style, duration, easing curve, timing).

tools.name: figma_get_focused_slide
tools.summary: Get the slide currently focused in single-slide view.

tools.name: figma_create_slide
tools.summary: Create a new blank slide in the Figma Slides presentation.

tools.name: figma_duplicate_slide
tools.summary: Duplicate an existing slide.

tools.name: figma_add_text_to_slide
tools.summary: Add a new text element to a specific slide.

tools.name: figma_add_shape_to_slide
tools.summary: Add a rectangle or ellipse shape to a specific slide with optional fill color.

tools.name: figma_set_slide_transition
tools.summary: Set the transition effect for a slide (style, duration, easing curve).

tools.name: figma_set_slide_background
tools.summary: Set the background color of a slide.

tools.name: figma_skip_slide
tools.summary: Toggle whether a slide is skipped during presentation mode.

tools.name: figma_reorder_slides
tools.summary: Reorder slides by providing a new 2D array of slide IDs.

tools.name: figma_focus_slide
tools.summary: Navigate to and focus a specific slide in single-slide view.

tools.name: figma_set_slides_view_mode
tools.summary: Toggle the Figma Slides viewport between grid view and single-slide view.

tools.name: figma_delete_slide
tools.summary: Delete a slide from the presentation.

description: extract a design system from app code (figma_ds_*)

tools.name: figma_ds_analyze
tools.summary: Analyze one or more production app codebases as the first step of design system extraction.

tools.name: figma_ds_extract_tokens
tools.summary: Extract design tokens from analyzed codebases into canonical DTCG JSON (plus optional CSS variables / Tailwind / SCSS / TypeScript projections).

tools.name: figma_ds_scaffold
tools.summary: Generate the design-system package skeleton at outDir from a completed analysis + token extraction: package.json (app framework as peer deps), src/components layout, token files via the shared formatt

tools.name: figma_ds_setup_storybook
tools.summary: Wire a freshly-initialized Storybook workshop to the extracted design system — run AFTER `npm create storybook@latest` inside outDir.

tools.name: figma_ds_extract_component
tools.summary: Deep-extract ONE component from the inventory for porting into the design system: returns its source (capped), local import closure (relative imports to follow), prop contract, observed call-site vari

tools.name: figma_ds_verify
tools.summary: Run the deterministic fidelity evals on an extracted design system package — the governance gate before handing off or pushing to Figma.

tools.name: figma_ds_status
tools.summary: Read or update design-system extraction porting progress (persisted in <outDir>/.extraction/status.json so long engagements survive session boundaries).
